correctness.rationale: Directly reconstructed the conditional parent-choice recurrences for a_n=E F_n(z), b_n=E G_n(z), and C_n=Cov(L_n,F_n(z)); the shared chosen-parent term is crucial. Solving C_{n+1}=[1+(z-1)/n]C_n+z(1-z)a_n/[2n(1+z)] with C_2=0 gives the exact polynomial (including removable z=-1). Fourier inversion isolates the dominant conjugate roots omega and bar omega; Gamma ratio yields constant omega(1-omega)/(2 Gamma(2+omega)); beta=sin(2pi/q)>0 permits opposite phase subsequences. Independent enumeration of all parent choices for n=2..7 reproduced every rational polynomial coefficient, and the source checker was inspected rather than trusted as a proof. Finite enumeration does not prove all n or log-periodic asymptotics.

value.rationale: The leaf count and depth-residue profile are canonical terminal and geometric statistics of recursive trees. Their joint covariance phase boundary differs from the known variance boundary and supplies exact finite-n cross-moments and all-residue oscillation phases. The result is a motivated structural joint statistic rather than just a path-length derivative.

final_claim: For uniform random recursive trees, Cov(L_n,F_n(z))=(n-2)z(1-z)/4 product_{j=3}^{n-1}(j-1+z)/j. For each fixed depth modulus q>=3, leaf/depth-residue cross-covariances have nonzero log-periodic conjugate-root leading terms with amplitude n^{cos(2pi/q)}, giving vanishing q=3, bounded nonconvergent q=4, and subsequentially growing q>=5; all residue covariances change sign infinitely often.
limitations: Fixed q only; no uniformity in q growing with n or joint limit theorem.
Numerical/finite enumeration is supporting evidence only.
